alt: Four photos in img/ are embedded by vidore/colpali-v1.2 into bags of 128-d patch vectors and stored in the ImageSearchColpali multivector collection in Qdrant with the max_sim comparator; a newly added giraffe.jpg is indexed live, and the query "long neck" is matched token against patch to return img/giraffe.jpg.

run.note: Start the API; it indexes img/ live before it serves
In a second terminal, open the search UI at http://localhost:5173
run.cmd: cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev
